[Pending Restart] - Corrected the tag of Heroic Raid, Mythic Raid, Ascended Raid Items. They will now always correspond to "Difficulty Raid" tag. This helps alleviate confusion where some items from Mythic Raids were called Mythic Raid items and Mythic Raid Tier Tokens were only called Mythic.

[Area-52] - [Thrall] - [Pending Restart] - Horizontal Tier Token is available for all tiers currently available! This vendor allows you to purchase tier tokens for items that you've already acquired. Example: If I purchase an Arcanist Helm (heroic) I can now buy Heroic Tier Tokens for the Helm Slot in that tier. This allows those who are playing multiple specializations, adapting builds for upcoming changes or just want to try out something new is no longer limited by their tier choice. The current price is 100g per tier and a 50% increase in cost per difficulty. This means that Tier 1 Token (Normal) costs 100g. Tier 2 Token (Normal) costs 200g. Tier 1 Token (Mythic) costs 200g. Tier 2 Token (Mythic) costs 400g, Tier 2 Token (Ascended) costs 500g. You can access this vendor via the "Tier X" option where you exchange your tier tokens.

[Pending Restart] Sweeping Strikes has been reworked, it used to read : Your next 10 melee attacks and Warrior abilities strike an additional nearby opponent. While active, your attacks can not be blocked. 15 second duration.

This changelog was posted previously but wasn't posted correctly.
